title: The Conservation Status of the Sphagnum Species in Romania
content: New distribution data on Sphagnum species have led to the need for re-evaluation of their conservation status. The article presents the conservation status assessment of Romania’s Sphagnum species, carried out according to the latest IUCN criteria. Based on the analyzed data, 34 Sphagnum species are confirmed for Romania, one species requires confirmation, and 5 species are rejected. Over the past two years, three Sphagnum species were published as new to Romania. The re-evaluation of the conservation status of Sphagnum species in Romania has led to the assessment of eight threatened species, fewer than in the previous assessments.
